---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[feat] <tool>: <short summary>"
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Tool

Which tool is this for? (or "new tool" if proposing a new top-level tool)

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Why is the current behavior
insufficient?

## Proposed solution

Describe your idea. Include example CLI invocations or config snippets when
relevant.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches have you considered, and why is this one better?

## Additional context

Screenshots, links, or related issues.
